[02]the ratio
95% built by AI. 5% by humans. That's the goal.

work.split — target■ ai 95■ human 05



95%
The repeatable work runs on agents.
Intake, production, delivery, support, billing. Everything that used to need a department runs as a system — around the clock, at the same quality on the thousandth job as on the first.


5%
Humans own the judgment.
Strategy, taste and the final call. At No Hands Studio, that 5% is a senior designer finishing every detail.



// we're not chasing zero. the 5% is where the quality lives.

[03]the shift
For the first time, a company can be smaller than the work it does.

company.config−3 +3
1 # the work that used to need a department runs as a system that never clocks out
2−software: "a tool"
3+software: "the operator"

5 # every process a company added used to cost people. that ratio just broke
6−headcount: "leverage"
7+headcount: "drag"

9 # build the system first, and the company runs on it
10−startups: "founders"
11+startups: "an operating system"






[04]how we build
Four steps. The last one is the whole point.


01
find_wedge()
Find the wedge
A market where the work is repeatable, the margins get eaten by labour, and a system can simply do it better than a team can.

02
build_operator()
Build the operator
Agents that do the actual work — intake, production, delivery, support. Not a chatbot bolted onto a product. The company is the system.

03
ship_live()
Ship it live
Real customers, real money, from day one. If a company can only survive by hiring its way out of the work, it does not ship.

04
let_go()
Let go
We keep strategy and taste. Everything between a customer arriving and a customer being served runs on agents. We own the last 5%.
← the whole point
